notApplicable.KlySkipLink: A keyboard skip-to-content link for web focus order; native screen readers navigate by gesture.
notApplicable.KlyHead: Sends content to the HTML <head> of a Blazor web view; MAUI has no document head.
notApplicable.KlyFonts: Links generated @font-face CSS; in MAUI the app registers fonts at startup (ConfigureFonts).
notApplicable.KlyCultureMeta: A <meta> tag read by a WebAssembly client; the device culture is already native.
